notes: Curated research paths, not automatic adapters. Sources may be unavailable/outdated; check product-specific URL and shipping anew.
dailyStrategy: Prioritize 8-12 high-intent exact targets; rotate every remaining target; allow several dozen actual searches/checks, but never pretend all sources were checked.

targets.name: HEAD Padel Pro S+ and HEAD Padel Pro+ balls
targets.exactMatchRule: Only identical HEAD Pro S+ or Pro+ version, pack count and number of balls. Compare total delivered price and EUR per 3 balls. Bulk unit price alone is NOT a temporary discount
targets.priceEvidence: Show deal ONLY with >=10% independently verified real temporary reduction and concrete same-SKU comparable history; article price and NL shipping included; without history no verified deal.

targets.name: Dyson Airwrap complete haarstyler
